value.rationale: The result resolves a genuine sampling issue: flow ergodicity can fail at resonant times, so ordinary integer-iterate transfer is insufficient. The ergodic-component/maximality argument shows that the complete intermediate entropy spectrum nevertheless survives every nonzero sample whenever the entropy witnesses are flow invariant. This immediately strengthens the scope of the motivating flow theorems from their time-one entropy formulation to all sampling times without imposing nonresonance.
